notes: Existing Avalonia 11 desktop Dispatch screen: ListBox of 8 pending jobs on the left, job detail form (Title/Customer/Priority/Pickup/Drop-off/Vehicle/Notes) with Save/Cancel on the right. DispatchViewModel already tracks HasChanges (dirty), but SelectedJob's setter calls LoadEditor() unconditionally, so selecting another row silently discards edits. The Save/Cancel/Ctrl+S commands in the menu bar and toolbar already exist and must stay. Expected fix: an unsaved-changes guard on selection change (and ideally on Vehicles/Settings navigation and window close) that keeps the dirty job selected and asks Save / Discard / Keep editing before switching; a visible dirty indicator in the heading (e.g. 'Unsaved changes' text, not colour alone); the prompt must be a modal, focus-trapped dialog styled with the existing flat bordered surfaces (white panel, 1px LineBrush border, 4px radius, no shadow), default button = the safe option, Esc = keep editing, focus returns to the form afterwards. Reuse Button/Button.accent/Border.surface; no new visual language. Keep menu bar + toolbar + status bar, light theme, Segoe UI/Inter.
